messages:
alex.k: quick check — putting the train into preflight now. cut window opens in ~2h. cherrypicks queued: #1845, #1851, #1858. canary target: train-2026-03-17/us-west-2. please shout if any must-blocks.

mira: looking at #1858, e2e failing on arm runners. repro locally with qemu. logs show grpc timeout in setup step. :thinking_face:

sam: pinging infra — @oncall-sre can we either bump the job timeout or repro infra issue? current infra quota looks fine.

oncall-sre: increased runner timeout to 45s for job `e2e-arm` and requeued the job. watching.

jen: FYI I had to backport a tiny auth fix to #1845. CI is green but it touches the auth proxy deploy config — would like infra to give a quick 👍 before we merge.

alex.k: thanks. plan: prefer only green cherrypicks in this cut. sam, can you pick up #1851 if mira needs help finishing #1858?

sam: on it. starting review now. if CI stays green and no infra changes, will merge.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for train-2026-03-17 in us-west-2 — 10% nodes. https://deployments.internal/release/train-2026-03-17 :rocket:

mira: after the timeout bump the job passed. still looks flaky but ok to include in canary. left a note in the PR about the intermittent grpc setup failure.

jen: added a short deploy note in the changelog: "auth proxy backport (minor config)". if canary trips, fallback should target model-variant v1.2 per rollback policy.

alex.k: current action: merge only #1845 and #1858 after final CI; hold #1851 until post-canary signoff. will tag @release_conductor when canary hits 50%.

sam: merged #1845 — :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: canary at 50% now. monitoring dashboards look nominal. small latency bump (~+3%) but within SLO.

alex.k: :thumbsup: wait for 15m stable window then promote to 100%. appreciate the quick turn on the arm flake.
